units.source_text: 猛然响起一个可怕的声音，塞住了他的嘴。

en.t: A terrible sound suddenly rang out, stopping his mouth.

units.source_text: 正像昨晚上女人说的，北边的沙檐，失去了水分，散了架，嘭地掉落下来。

en.t: Just as the woman had said the night before, the sand eaves on the north side had lost their moisture, come apart, and fallen down with a thud.

units.source_text: 房子整个儿被强行扭曲了似的，发出了哀婉的悲鸣。

en.t: The whole house seemed to have been forcibly twisted, and it gave out a mournful, plaintive cry.

units.source_text: 然后，柱子和墙壁之间，稀里哗啦，痛苦地溢出一些灰色的血来。

en.t: Then, from between the pillars and the walls, with a clattering rustle, some gray blood seemed to ooze out in pain.

units.source_text: 男人包了一嘴的唾沫，浑身颤抖起来。

en.t: The man held a mouthful of saliva and began trembling all over.

units.source_text: 简直就像他自己被砸碎了一样……

en.t: It was almost as if he himself had been smashed to pieces...
